_comment: Post-publish validation manifest. Defines expected custom fields per entity after a successful Acumatica customization publish. Used by validate-publish.py to verify fields exist in live API responses.

PurchaseOrder._note_disabled: UsrExpArrivalDate, UsrActArrivalDate, UsrContainerRef removed from validation — these fields exist in AesthetikContainers DAC but don't appear in REST API schema after publish. Known issue since ISV consolidation. Columns exist in SQL.

_notes.UsrDisablePayLink: CustomerExt : PXCacheExtension<Customer> field. Works on AR303000 screen and in C# (ARInvoiceEntry_PayLink_Extension), but NOT exposed via REST API $adHocSchema for Customer entity. SQL column on BAccount table. Cannot validate via REST API schema check — only via sql_columns.
_notes.UsrComplianceHold: SOOrderExt DAC + graph extension exist but ALTER TABLE fails silently on Acumatica cloud. Columns need manual creation via SM203510. Once columns exist, fields will appear in $adHocSchema and can be promoted to custom_fields.
